headline: Former Man United midfielder Herrera on City breaches: 'Damage irreparable'
description: Former Manchester United midfielder Ander Herrera is bitter over the EPL title he was deprived of during Manchester City's decade of rules breaching.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Everton eye loan for Man United's Rashford
description: Everton are weighing up a January loan for Manchester United forward Marcus Rashford. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Gary Neville tells the Glazers to sell their stakes in Manchester United
description: Former Manchester United captain Gary Neville has told the Glazers "enough is enough" and to sell their stake in the club.

headline: Xabi Alonso: Estêvão will 'have his moment' at Chelsea
description: Chelsea coach Xabi Alonso insists Estêvão will have "his moment" this season, with the teenage winger having only played 172 minutes.

headline: Enzo Maresca: Man City 'never practiced penalties' before shootout win
description: Man City boss Enzo Maresca said his players had not practiced penalties after edging past Brighton in a Carabao Cup shootout on Wednesday.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Juventus eye move for USMNT's Balogun
description: AS Monaco and USMNT striker Folarin Balogun is reportedly linked with a move to Juventus. Transfer Talk has the latest.
